increment_paragraph: **FB-CHUNK-LIFECYCLE** (round 37; Fluent Bit priority 1, FB-BACKLOG-CUSTODY remaining arms; new gateway rule 90; Lean `QCore.StaticConstantFormal`; [report](../../reports/fb-chunk-lifecycle/README.md)). `sb_remove_chunk_from_segregated_backlog` (`sb.c:214-246`) frees the wrapper it unlinks only `if (destroy)`, and its one call passes `FLB_TRUE`; read over an unconstrained `destroy`, the system row was a provisional Unsafe on a false arm no invocation reaches (P0-SB-REMOVE-CHUNK-DESTROY-FLAG). Rule 90 reads a `static` function at its callers' actuals: when every occurrence of its identifier is its declarator, a file-scope prototype or a direct call, every call passes a decimal constant (at most four digits, matched parentheses only) of one truth at an integer formal (`const`/`int`/`signed`/`unsigned`/`_Bool`), the body spells that formal only as `if (NAME)` / `if (!NAME)`, and the CFG shows exactly those two-way branches (no loop header, no cell test), each branch becomes a `NoOp` keeping the arm C takes (rule 11x's contextual selection; no node removed), and every row reaching the function carries the premise `static-call-sites-closed`. One hook in `build_function_cfg_with` (`legacy_c.rs`), module `legacy_static_constant_formal.rs`. Pinned (`tests/clang_gap_phase4/static_constant_formal.rs`): the release-only-if-destroy body with every call passing 1 (one or two calls, two callers, `((1))`, `1` and `2`, beside a prototype, under `if`/`else`, cast to `void`) and the negated test under 0 move Unsafe -> Safe over the fixtures; the leaking arm selected by 0 (or 1 under `!`) stays Unsafe; mixed, variable, escaped (`fp = subject`, `&subject`, a table designator), absent, out-of-range, octal, signed, suffixed or cast actuals, a block-scope declaration, external linkage, `volatile`/`char` formals, a compound condition, a written or shadowed formal and a `while` test keep the old reading. System slice (`current --selection system-selection.json`, 046accf6, base and tip each from its own archive and release binary): 114 / 0 / 329 / 5 -> 114 / 0 / 330 / 4, units 0 / 12 / 3 -> 0 / 13 / 2; the one move is the predicted `sb_remove_chunk_from_segregated_backlog` Unsafe -> Unknown (the leak leaf gone; the indirect access in its size-accounting block and the withdrawn specification stay), unit `sb.c` Unsafe -> Unknown. Opt-in `current` (`--monkey-linked`): 1,205 / 2 / 3,590 / 7 on both sides, no status or leaf move (predicted none); the selection also fires on header-level static helpers in 22 librdkafka units, so 497 rows list the premise (12 of them Safe at base, an added assumption only). A census of the chunk-lifecycle rows (`sb.c`, `flb_input_chunk.c`) places every remaining Unknown with its owner: the accounting reads (FB-BACKLOG-ACCOUNTING), ChunkIO return codes, the reference relation, `flb_input_chunk_map`'s arms and the reachable-release cascade; the partial fan-out arm, premature close and double ownership stay Unknown, never Safe. Pinned routes not run (no inputs on the host). GATE_SENTENCE
